title: Atomic JSON write failed on a Windows sharing violation during the full-suite gate
summary: The ORCH-0027 full-suite gate raised PermissionError [WinError 5] in tests/test_workflows.py::test_skill_route_is_prepared_and_resume_safe: storage.write_json's os.replace of .agent-local/handoffs/personal-agent-os.json was denied while another handle (concurrent reader, indexer or antivirus) held the target. The change under test did not touch workflows, compiler or storage; the test passed 3/3 on rerun, so it is transient. Because every Agent OS ledger and run record goes through write_json, a real run could hit the same transient error, so the fix is in production code, not the test: storage._replace retries PermissionError up to 5 times with 50 ms exponential backoff (<1 s total) and re-raises on the last attempt; other errors are not retried.
